items.summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. items.summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. items.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. items.summary: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. items.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
items.summary: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. items.summary: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. items.title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
items.summary: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. items.summary: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. items.summary: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. items.summary: Code-search benchmarks show dense encoders well ahead of BM25, yet coding agents do well with grep. What does this dense advantage measure?
